summary: Make clean Linux compiler builds self-contained with pinned CMake/Ninja/patchelf and the build venv PATH, then validate the installed Linux ARM64 wheel.
regressions: The unmodified helper failed with CMakeNotFoundError in the CANN 9.2.1 Ubuntu 22.04 image. After installing the recorded build prerequisites, the clean pinned-source build and wheel installation passed on Python 3.12.16.

Fresh Linux lowering produced identical kernel sources and complete frame manifests for both 416-stage prepared CUDA/Ascend schedules (92 unique sources each), in 67.125 and 40.095 seconds. Thirteen focused host ABI/compiler/frame/replay tests passed on the installed wheel in 1.559 seconds.
differences: No shaders, physics, numerical tolerances or Rust reference behavior changed. The cross-host probe reuses verified native initial buffers; it does not execute the reference or device physics. Linux x86, native Windows and actual accelerators remain unqualified. Full matrix and reconciliation remain unrequested.
